name: Cooperative AI Foundation Research Grants (incl. Early-Career Track)
amount: Min GBP 10,000; early-career track max GBP 100,000 (up to 12 months); past grants GBP 10k-385k (median ~GBP 150k); overhead max 10% of direct costs
duration: Up to 12 months (early-career track); up to 2 years (standard)
eligibility: Researchers anywhere; early-career track for postdocs/junior researchers typically within 2-3 years of PhD; projects in cooperative AI research areas
eligibility_note: Grants page: 'applicants can be located anywhere in the world'; affiliation helpful but not required.
how_to_apply_tip: Early-career track fits a 0-3 yr postdoc exactly; read their research-area list and sign up to the newsletter, since rounds open with a pre-proposal stage.
deadline_quote: Our first grant deadline for 2025 has passed and we are no longer accepting applications. ... To stay informed about future opportunities, please sign up for our newsletter below or revisit this page for updates.
verdict_reason: Your PhD was awarded Jan 2024, so by a 2027 round you will be ~3+ years post-PhD, at or beyond the 2-3 years the early-career track 'expects' for most applicants (a soft expectation, not a bar); the standard track has no PhD-age limit, and there is no nationality, institution, age or gender restriction. No round is currently open.
eligibility_quote: You can be located anywhere in the world. ... An affiliation can, in many cases, strengthen your proposal, but is not required. ... We expect most early-career applicants to apply within 2-3 years of completing their PhD.

name: AI2050 Early Career Fellowship
amount: Not stated on official page (award supports a three-year project; USD 300,000 figure not confirmed)
eligibility: Postdoctoral and pre-tenure researchers from around the world; nomination only
eligibility_note: Fellows page: aimed at researchers 'from around the world'; closed nomination process, no open application.
how_to_apply_tip: Cannot self-apply: ask your institution or senior collaborators connected to AI2050 to nominate you; build a visible beneficial-AI research agenda.
deadline_quote: AI2050 Early Career Fellows are selected using a closed nomination process, so there is no application.
verdict_reason: Nomination-only; official page targets 'postdoctoral and pre-tenure researchers' and is silent on nationality/institution. Unclear whether an Associate Professor counts as pre-tenure.
eligibility_quote: AI2050 Early Career Fellows are selected using a closed nomination process, so there is no application. ... encourage postdoctoral and pre-tenure researchers from around the world.
ask_funder: Does an untenured Associate Professor at a private transnational college in Pakistan, whose PhD was awarded in January 2024, count as 'pre-tenure' for AI2050 Early Career nomination, and who may nominate?

name: Science of Trustworthy AI RFP
amount: Tier 1 up to USD 1M; Tier 2 USD 1-5M (indirects capped 10%)
eligibility: Individual researchers or teams at universities/research institutions, including international institutions
eligibility_note: FAQ (draft) lists international institutions as eligible subject to 501(c)(3)-equivalency evaluation.
how_to_apply_tip: Large grants; best approached as co-PI with an international collaborator. Start NGOSource equivalency early.
deadline_quote: Official Schmidt Sciences RFP page (schmidtsciences.org/?p=14603) returned 404; Opportunities page no longer lists the Science of Trustworthy AI RFP. University listings (pointer only) give 'Proposal Due Date May 17, 2026, 11:59PM AoE'.
verdict_reason: Official FAQ allows international institutions but requires the funded recipient to hold 501(c)(3) or equivalent status and bars for-profit leads; a private TNE college (Beaconhouse group) may not qualify. Last-known deadline not confirmed on funder domain.
eligibility_quote: The recipient of funding must hold a 501c3 designation or equivalent. The following entities are eligible to apply: Individual Researchers or Project Teams at Universities or Research Institutions (Including International Institutions) ... No. For-profit entities cannot lead projects. ... Indirect costs must not exceed 10% for the entire project.
ask_funder: Can a PI at Beaconhouse International College (private TNE college in Pakistan, part of a private education group) lead a proposal, and would the college need an NGOsource 501(c)(3)-equivalency determination? When will the next Trustworthy AI RFP open?

name: Wikimedia Research Fund
amount: Type 1: USD 2,000-50,000 (12 months); Type 2: up to USD 150,000 (max 75k/yr, 24 months); Type 3: up to USD 50,000
duration: Up to 12 months (Type 1/3); up to 24 months (Type 2)
eligibility: Individuals, groups, organisations; established researchers in Wikimedia research or wishing to enter it (NLP, ML, knowledge graphs fit well)
eligibility_note: No country restriction; welcomes 'all regions of the world' and particularly encourages Asia, Africa, Latin America, Eastern Europe.
how_to_apply_tip: Strong fit for Urdu/regional-language NLP on Wikipedia/Wikidata; use the program's 1:1 office hours before the January LOI.
deadline_quote: Submissions for Type I and II Research Proposals are now closed. (2025-26 cycle: Letter of Intent January 16, 2026; full proposals April 3, 2026; all deadlines 23:59 Anywhere on Earth.)
verdict_reason: Individuals may apply; no country, institution, age or gender restriction on the official page, and Asia is explicitly encouraged. Next cycle not yet announced.
eligibility_quote: Individuals, groups, and organizations may apply ... established Wikimedia researchers, or established researchers who want to become Wikimedia researchers ... particularly encourages researchers in Central and South America, Africa, Eastern Europe, and Asia.

name: ISIF Asia Grants
eligibility: Organisations (government, private, NGO incl. universities) registered in APNIC service region; Internet-for-development projects
eligibility_note: Lead organisation must be registered in one of 56 APNIC economies; Pakistan is in the service region. Individuals cannot apply.
how_to_apply_tip: Apply through your university/ORIC as the lead organisation; frame an AI-enabled connectivity or community-network project.
deadline_quote: The call for concept notes for ISIF Asia 2026 has now closed. ... The next round of concept notes will be open in 2027.
verdict_reason: Any organisation type (incl. private companies) registered in an APNIC economy may lead; Pakistan is in the APNIC Foundation service region. Must apply through BIC as lead organisation, not as an individual.
eligibility_quote: Individuals are not eligible to apply. ... Any kind of organisation can apply, including government departments, private companies, and non-government organisations ... led by an organisation registered in one of the 56 economies in the APNIC Foundation service region. (Service region page, South Asia: Pakistan, PK.)

name: COMSTECH-TWAS Programme for Young Scientists in OIC (Joint Research Grants)
eligibility: OIC nationals with PhD, early-career, generally under 40, at a university/research institution in an OIC country; fields include IT and computer sciences
eligibility_note: COMSTECH page: 'nationals of OIC Member States ... working at a university or research institution in an OIC country'. Pakistan is an OIC member and COMSTECH host.
how_to_apply_tip: Program page looks dated (2017 stats); email COMSTECH (comstech@comstech.org) to confirm the current cycle. Cannot apply to TWAS Research Grants in same year.
deadline_quote: The COMSTECH programme page states no application deadline or dates; the linked TWAS opportunity page returned HTTP 403.
verdict_reason: Age rule 'under the age of 40' may exclude a 36-45 applicant if 40+; also requires a position at a 'university or research institution' (TNE college status unclear); programme currency unconfirmed.
eligibility_quote: Individual applicants must be nationals of OIC Member States, with a PhD ... They should hold positions at universities or research institutions in one of the OIC countries. ... the grants are awarded to competent scientists under the age of 40 years.
ask_funder: Is the COMSTECH-TWAS Joint Research Grant still running in 2026-27 and when is the next deadline? Is the under-40 age limit strict, and does a private transnational college (Beaconhouse International College) count as a research institution?

name: Internet Society Foundation Research Grant Programme
amount: Independent researchers up to USD 200,000; institutions up to USD 500,000
eligibility: Independent researchers with PhD/Master's and publications, or public universities/public research institutions; applied, open research on Inclusive/Green/Trustworthy Internet, meaningful connectivity
eligibility_note: Programme described as open to researchers and public institutions 'around the world'; private institutions not eligible; Foundation has funded multiple Pakistan projects. Check grantee eligibility/compliance document.
how_to_apply_tip: Apply via a public university (private universities are ineligible as institutions) or as an independent PI; register in Fluxx at least 24h before deadline. AI angle: trustworthy internet / network measurement with ML.
deadline_quote: Applications will be accepted from 7 April to 22 May 2026, at 21:00 UTC. (Status: Closed.)
verdict_reason: BIC as a private institution is explicitly ineligible; the only route is as an 'independent researcher' with PhD and publications, and it is unclear whether a full-time employee of a private college qualifies.
eligibility_quote: Private institutions are not eligible entities to receive funding. ... Independent researchers may apply for funding up to US$200,000. ... Independent researchers ... should have a postgraduate research degree (PhD, Masters) and peer reviewed publications.
ask_funder: Can a full-time Associate Professor at a private college in Pakistan apply as an 'independent researcher' (funds paid to the individual), given private institutions are ineligible? When will the 2027 round open?

name: APNIC Foundation Research Fellowships
eligibility: Residents of APNIC service region; master's+ degree, 7-10 years field experience, at least one first-author peer-reviewed paper; tracks incl. Sustainable AI, DPI, Internet infrastructure
eligibility_note: Must reside in one of 56 APNIC service-region economies; Pakistan (PK) is listed under South Asia on the service-region page.
how_to_apply_tip: The 7-10 years experience bar may count PhD research years; apply in the Sustainable AI track with a policy-relevant output.
deadline_quote: The 2026 Research Fellowship is now closed for applications. (Applications closed: 31 March 2026, 11:59 PM (UTC+10).)
verdict_reason: Residence (Pakistan in APNIC region), degree and publication criteria are met, but the '7-10 years of experience' requirement is not defined and the profile does not state total field experience.
eligibility_quote: Reside in one of the 56 economies in the Asia Pacific that are serviced by the APNIC ... Hold at least a Master's-level degree ... Demonstrate a minimum of 7-10 years of experience in their respective fields ... at least one first-author original research piece published in a relevant peer-reviewed ...
ask_funder: Does academic teaching/research experience before and during the PhD count toward the 7-10 years of field experience, and when will the 2027 fellowship call open?

name: OIC-COMSTECH Research Grant Program for Young Women Researchers
eligibility: Young women researchers from OIC member states (women only)
eligibility_note: Open to young women researchers from OIC member states; Pakistan is an OIC member.
how_to_apply_tip: Only relevant if the applicant is female; 690 proposals in last round, so keep the budget tight and the deliverables specific.
verdict_reason: Women-only programme; the profile is male.
eligibility_quote: Small Grants are awarded to young women researchers actively involve in scientific research in OIC countries. ... Be under 45 years of age on closing date.

name: PSF Industrial Solution Grants for Young Scientists
funder: Pakistan Science Foundation (PSF) – R&D Industry Programme
eligibility: Young scientists (PI at a Pakistani institution) proposing applied solutions to industrial problems with MS/MPhil/PhD student engagement and an industry partner
eligibility_note: Domestic PSF call for researchers at Pakistani institutions; official notice not directly retrievable – verified via PSF RGMS guide and university ORIC postings
how_to_apply_tip: Secure a letter of commitment from an industry partner and submit via RGMS; AI for manufacturing/quality control fits well.
deadline_quote: Concept Paper Submission Guide: Industrial Solution Grants for Young Scientists. Deadline: 31st March 2026
verdict_reason: PSF guide only requires a PI at a Pakistani institution plus an MS/PhD student and industry Co-PI; 'young scientist' age/PhD-year limit and accepted institution types are not stated, and BIC does not run MS/PhD programmes.
eligibility_quote: There are three elements for this grant: i) a PI (Principal Investigator) working at a Pakistani Institution, ii) a student of MS/Ph.D, iii) a CoPI from Industry.
ask_funder: How old can you be, or how many years after your PhD, to count as a 'young scientist'? My PhD was awarded in January 2024. Is a private TNE college (BIC) an eligible PI institution? Can the MS/PhD student come from another university? When is the next call?

name: Amazon Research Awards (ARA) – Fall 2026 Call for Proposals
amount: Unrestricted gift and/or AWS credits; amount determined by Amazon in its sole discretion
eligibility: PI must be full-time faculty at an accredited academic institution, or a permanent researcher at a recognised non-profit. Topics in Fall 2026 include Agentic AI, AI for Information Security, Automated Reasoning, Multilingual & Contextual AI Evaluation, On-Device Multimodal Perception, Synthetic Data for Multimodal Perception, Build on Trainium.
eligibility_note: Program rules void only in Cuba, Iran, Syria, North Korea and Crimea/Luhansk/Donetsk; PI must attest not under US export controls or sanctions. Pakistan not excluded. Postdocs are not listed as eligible PIs – need a faculty (e.g. Assistant Professor) appointment.
how_to_apply_tip: Deadline is very close (extended to Nov 11); pick exactly one listed topic, and if you are a postdoc, apply via a faculty colleague as PI or wait for the Spring 2027 call once you hold a faculty post.
deadline_quote: Fall 2026: Open Now ... The submission period has been extended to November 11. (No time zone given.)
verdict_reason: Pakistan is not in the void list and Associate Professor is a faculty post, but rules require 'an accredited academic institution'; whether a private TNE college delivering UK partner degrees counts is not addressed.
eligibility_quote: the Principal Investigator must be (1) either a full-time faculty member at an accredited academic institution ... The ARA Program is void in Cuba, Iran, Syria, North Korea and the Crimea, Luhansk and Donetsk regions of Ukraine ... All Award amounts will be determined by Amazon in its sole discretion.
ask_funder: Is a full-time Associate Professor at Beaconhouse International College (private college in Pakistan delivering University of Essex / LJMU degrees, not itself degree-awarding) at an 'accredited academic institution' for ARA, and can the gift be paid to BIC?

name: Cisco Research Gifts (Open RFPs)
eligibility: PI must be full-time faculty or research staff at a university/research institution; non-US institutions must show non-profit equivalency. Current open RFPs: quantum networking, semiconductor reliability, conference sponsorships (topics rotate).
eligibility_note: No explicit country list on the official page; non-US institutions eligible if they prove non-profit status; US export-control screening likely.
how_to_apply_tip: Check the open-RFPs page monthly for AI/ML/security topics; one funded proposal per PI at a time.
deadline_quote: Cisco is currently accepting research proposals on [the topics listed under Open RFPs]: Quantum networks for distributed quantum computing and sensing; Harnessing Quantum Networking to Enhance Classical Applications; Semiconductor Reliability; Conference Sponsorships. No deadlines are stated.
verdict_reason: PI as full-time faculty fits, but non-US institutions must prove non-profit equivalency, which a private college may lack; current RFPs are not AI/robotics.
eligibility_quote: Applicant and PI must each be a full-time faculty or research staff member at a university or other research institution. ... Non-U.S. institutions must provide proof of non-profit equivalency. ... Cisco Research will only fund a PI one proposal at a time.
ask_funder: Can a private college in Pakistan (Beaconhouse International College) receive a Cisco research gift if it cannot show non-profit status, and are AI/robotics RFPs planned?

name: Ethereum Foundation Ecosystem Support Program (Wishlist & RFP grants)
amount: Based on scope (RFPs may give budget guidance); paid in ETH
eligibility: Open-source, non-commercial projects (incl. research) improving Ethereum, aligned with censorship resistance, open source, privacy, security; individuals, academics and teams.
eligibility_note: Official applicants page mentions no country restrictions.
how_to_apply_tip: Respond to a specific Wishlist/RFP item (e.g. cryptography, ZK, security/ML tooling); reviews take 3–6 weeks.
deadline_quote: There are currently no active wishlists available for application. ... There are currently no active Request for Proposals available for application. ... There are no active grant rounds at this time.
verdict_reason: Official applicants page states no country, institution, age or gender restriction (even for-profits may apply for open-source work); however, nothing is currently open to apply to.
eligibility_quote: ESP supports eligible projects working to improve Ethereum ... For-profit companies are welcome to apply if the grant-funded work is open-source. (No country restrictions stated.)

name: Google Academic Research Awards (GARA)
amount: Not stated on official pages; amount at Google's sole discretion (USD 100,000 figure not confirmed)
eligibility: Professors (assistant, associate, etc.) at degree-granting institutions; postdocs may only be Co-PIs. Topics change each cycle (2026 cycle: quantum computing algorithms and security).
eligibility_note: Official page describes it as a global call and lists no country restrictions; standard US sanctions exclusions presumably apply (Pakistan not sanctioned).
how_to_apply_tip: Topics rotate each year (GARA replaced the Research Scholar Program); watch the page from May 2027 and team up with a faculty PI if you are still a postdoc.
deadline_quote: During the open application period between June 26 – August 7, 2026 ... (Timeline: June 26: Applications open; August 7: Applications close; October 30: Notification of proposal decisions.)
verdict_reason: Terms allow 'public or private academic or research institution' and Pakistan is not excluded, but the program page limits PIs to professors 'at degree-granting institutions'; BIC is not itself degree-awarding.
eligibility_quote: open to professors (assistant, associate, etc.) at degree-granting institutions ... [Terms] public or private academic or research institution ... Organizations located in Crimea, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia or Syria and Projects in those countries are not eligible to apply.
ask_funder: Does a private college delivering UK partner-university degrees (not itself degree-awarding) qualify as a 'degree-granting institution' for GARA, and when will the 2027 cycle open?

name: AWS Cloud Credit for Research
amount: AWS Promotional Credits; no cap for faculty/staff (based on proposal), students up to USD 5,000
duration: Per proposal (credits have a validity period)
eligibility: Full-time faculty, full-time research staff, or graduate/PhD students at accredited research institutions (postdocs apply as full-time research staff).
eligibility_note: Official page states no country restriction; AWS standard sanctions exclusions apply and Pakistan is not sanctioned.
how_to_apply_tip: Reviews take 90–120 days with no expedite, so apply well before you need compute; include a detailed AWS pricing-calculator estimate.
deadline_quote: Amazon Web Services (AWS) will evaluate academic research support proposals on a rolling basis throughout the year. ... Typical review cycles are 90 to 120 days.
verdict_reason: Full-time faculty are eligible, but only at 'an accredited research institution'; the official page does not define accreditation or address country eligibility.
eligibility_quote: Full-time faculty at an accredited research institution ... Student awards will be up to a maximum of $5,000.00. Faculty and Staff awards are not capped.
ask_funder: Does Beaconhouse International College (private TNE college in Pakistan, not HEC degree-awarding) count as an 'accredited research institution', and are Pakistan-based applicants eligible?
